question: Jamda folk dance is associated with which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jamda** is a traditional folk dance form native to the state of **Jharkhand in India.**
 
• The dance is an integral part of the** rich cultural fabric of the region.**
 
• It is performed during various **social and cultural **events.
 
• The dance reflects the everyday activities and **cultural richness** of the communities in Jharkhand.
 
• As with many traditional dances, music is an essential component of the Jamda dance.
 
• This folk dance, among others, aids in preserving and promoting the unique and diverse cultural heritage of Jharkhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Other states and their folk dances:**
